title: Base de Données GISCOP84
summary: A university database-integration project building relational MySQL databases (GISCOP84 and PESTIMAT) to study occupational cancers linked to pesticide exposure, including a script to generate synthetic patient data. SDV is only listed as a commented-out dependency in requirements.txt with no corresponding import or call found in the code.
evidence: requirements.txt: '# sdv>=1.0.0' (commented out); no SDV pattern hits in code
needs: SDV dependency is commented out and generate_synthetic_data.py was not matched by any SDV usage pattern, so it's unclear whether SDV is actually used to produce the synthetic patient data mentioned in the README.
